title: 국회행정심판위원회규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00228:20210629:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum <National Assembly Rule No. 228, June 29, 2021>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their adoption by the National Assembly.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Establishment of Committee)
The National Assembly Secretariat Administrative Appeals Committee established under the previous provisions at the time these Rules enter into force shall be deemed the National Assembly Administrative Appeals Committee established under these Rules.
Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning Members)
Members commissioned or designated under the previous provisions at the time these Rules enter into force shall be deemed to have been commissioned or designated under these Rules for the remainder of their terms of office.
